q: By the oath of Mount Toor
v.s: By the mount
v.c: By Mount Ṭûr!

v.s: And [by] a Book inscribed
v.c: And by the Book written

q: (to be made available for reading on the Day of Qiyaamah).
v.s: In parchment spread open
v.c: on open pages ˹for all to read˺!

q: (“The Frequently Visited House”, referring to the place in the heavens directly above the Kabah where the angels make Tawaaf)...
v.s: And [by] the frequented House
v.c: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited!

v.s: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
v.c: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺!

v.s: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
v.c: And by the seas set on fire!

q: Indeed, the punishment of your Rabb shall take place
v.s: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
v.c: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

q: There shall be none to avert
v.s: Of it there is no preventer.
v.c: none will avert it—

q: The day when the sky shall tremble uncontrollably...
v.s: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
v.c: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently,

q: ...and the mountains will fly through the air
(as dust particles after being reduced to dust).
v.s: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
v.c: and the mountains will be blown away entirely.

q: (those who reject the coming of Qiyaamah)
v.s: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
v.c: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

q: (who enjoy themselves by doing as they please without caring for the day when they will have to account for everything they do).
v.s: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
v.c: those who amuse themselves with falsehood!

q: when they will be forcibly shoved
v.s: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
v.c: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell.

q: (It will then be said to them,)
“This is the Fire that you used to deny
v.s: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny.

q: (as you used to say about the miracles and scriptures of the Ambiyaa ﵊)
or are you unable to see?”
(Today you are unable to deny its existence!)
v.s: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
v.c: Is this magic, or do you not see?

q: “Enter into it! Whether you bear it with patience or you do not, it will make no difference to you!
(In any event, your suffering will be the same.)
You are being punished only for what
(You are not being oppressed without reason.)
v.s: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
v.c: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

v.s: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
v.c: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss,

q: Their Rabb shall save them from the punishment of the Blaze
v.s: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
v.c: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire.

q: “Eat and drink with blessings in return for the
v.s: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

q: They will be reclining on couches arranged in rows and We shall marry them to fair maidens with large
v.s: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
v.c: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes.

q: who do good deeds and whose progeny
We shall join their progeny with them
(in Jannah, and this privilege of having their family with them in Jannah will be given to them)
(However, the Kuffaar will be unable to join their Mu'mineen relatives in Jannah because)
v.s: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
v.c: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed.

q: (Continuing with the bounties of the Mu'mineen in Jannah, Allaah says,)
v.s: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
v.c: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire.

m: They will pass to one another
q: (The wine and other drinks of Jannah will not intoxicate people.)
v.s: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
v.c: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness.

q: (because of their beauty and refined manners).
v.s: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
v.c: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls.

q: will face each other asking questions.
v.s: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
v.c: They will turn to one another inquisitively.

v.s: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing God].
v.c: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people.

q: “However, Allaah favoured us and saved us from the punishment of the scorching wind
v.s: So God conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
v.c: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat.

q: (to save us from Jahannam). (Allaah answered our prayers because)
He is certainly the One who treats with kindness, the Most Merciful.”
v.s: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
v.c: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”

q: for, by the grace of your Rabb, you are neither a fortune-teller
v.s: So remind, [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
v.c: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman.
v.h: Why Do Meccans Deny the Truth?

q: is a poet whose calamity of time
v.s: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?
v.c: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”?

q: for I am also waiting with you
v.s: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
v.c: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”

q: (to reject Imaan despite being shown the proofs)
(not accepting Imaan simply because they are)
v.s: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
v.c: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people?

q: (they rejecting imaan and the Qur'aan because)
has forged it”? The fact of the matter is that they refuse to accept Imaan
(and will not accept despite every proof shown to them).
v.s: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
v.c: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith.

q: (in their claim that it is the speech of Rasulullaah ﷺ).
v.s: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
v.c: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true!

q: (if they refuse to believe in Allaah Who created them, then)
without a creator or are they
v.s: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
v.c: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators?

q: (if as they say, Allaah did not create everything, then)
create the heavens and the earth? The fact is that they have no conviction
(no faith in the fact that Allaah is The Only Creator and The Only Ilaah).
v.s: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
v.c: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺.

q: (if they do not have complete control)

(to distribute Allaah's bounties as they please)? (Since the Kuffaar have no say in the distribution of Allaah's favours, they have no say in who should be Allaah's Nabi and therefore have no right to object to Allaah's choice of Ambiyaa ﵊)
v.s: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
v.c: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺?

q: by which they are able to eavesdrop
(divine revelation that permits them to commit kufr)?
(if they have heard some revelation to substantiate their claims,)
let their eavesdropper produce a clear proof
(from this revelation to prove the legitimacy of their acts of kufr).
v.s: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
v.c: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof.

q: (Allaah, by saying that the angels are His daughters)
v.s: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
v.c: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons?

q: ask from them a fee so
(and because of this fee they feel as if)
(making it difficult for them to accept your message)?
v.s: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
v.c: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt?

q: (down to ensure that it continues)? (The fact is clear that the Kuffaar and Mushrikeen have nothing concrete to substantiate their beliefs and actions.)
v.s: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
v.c: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺?

q: (against Rasulullaah ﷺ which they are waiting to carry out)?
Indeed those who commit kufr will themselves be ensnared
v.s: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
v.c: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes.

q: they have an Ilaah besides Allaah? Allaah is Pure
from the partners they ascribe to Him.
(None can be an Ilaah but Allaah.)
v.s: Or have they a deity other than God? Exalted is God above whatever they associate with Him.
v.c: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺!

q: (towards them as a form of punishment)
v.s: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
v.c: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”

q: (after hearing the blast of the trumpet).’
v.s: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
v.c: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—

q: day when their schemes will be of no benefit to them
(but will rather be to their detriment)
and they will not be assisted
v.s: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
v.c: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped.

q: There shall surely be another punishment
v.s: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
v.c: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know.

q: (to allow the Kuffaar respite until the appointed time of their punishment)
for you are under Our protection
(and have nothing to fear from them).
Glorify the praises of your Rabb when you rise
v.s: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [God] with praise of your Lord when you arise
v.c: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise.

q: And glorify Him during a portion of the night
and even after the stars have vanished
v.s: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
v.c: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars.
